scope: Manager-tinted MVP cards on Honor Hall + Records Player, and full position-eligibility expansion on Rosters.
test_credentials: N/A — public Sleeper API, no auth.

fixed_in_this_iteration: Honor Hall: 3 MVP cards (Finals, Playoffs, Overall) now extract dominant color from the manager's CURRENT franchise logo via `tintFromImg` Svelte action and apply it as `--card-tint` for border, left-rail, radial-glow, eyebrow text, and PTS color. Verified 2025: all 3 cards by JFK4312 → olive-green (matches gopher's grass background).

Records Player: same `tintFromImg` action applied to 3 MVP cards. Verified 2023: Overall+Playoffs by zamt → crimson (matches Gilbert Arenas red avatar); Finals by jewishhorsemen → tan/brown (matches Harlem Globetrotters). The per-season roster_meta is now resolved through `latestMetaFor()` so it always reflects today's logo.

CORS workaround: Sleeper CDN sometimes serves cached non-CORS responses, so `dominantColor.js` routes Sleeper URLs through `images.weserv.nl` (free CORS-enabled image proxy). Non-Sleeper URLs pass through unchanged.

Rosters: every player pill now expands the basic fantasy_positions into the FULL eligibility set (PG → PG, G; SG → SG, G; SF → SF, F; PF → PF, F; C → C; everyone → UTIL). Verified: Quentin Grimes shows SG/G/UTIL, Josh Hart shows SG/SF/G/F/UTIL, etc. New helper at /app/src/lib/positions.js.
